scope: Freeze the 249 unlinked probable/confirmed identities at Goal activation; inventory all registered PDF holdings and their source appearances plus non-PDF-only sources, unlinked captures and zero-appearance holdings. This is a reproducible operational worklist, not a source investigation or scholarly completeness finding.
completion_conditions: Investigate every frozen publication identity with exact source identifiers and record attempted routes; explicit publication links and remaining operational blockers have different meanings.
Audit all held sources for eligible indexed and unindexed inscription/translation/image units; capture and separately check each available unit or record a source-backed absence/unrecoverable reason.
Preserve attribution, source hashes, locators, uncertainty and draft/revision history; private payloads remain private.
Maintain current roadmap, reader and receipts with tested local commits; blocked individual items lead to other actionable work.
inventory_limitations: An existing translation/transcription row is a presence indicator, not a complete edition guarantee. Latin transliteration and Hebrew-letter transliteration are not native-script recovery.
The 291 appearances with all existing edition rows checked do not certify missing-content coverage or specialist interpretation.
The 855 PDF-source appearances include contextual mentions, bibliography entries and objects without readable inscriptions; eligibility and absences need page evidence.
Nine PDF sources have no indexed appearances, and two PDF captures lack source links; inspect them rather than infer no eligible content.
All new campaign investigation statuses are pending. Older source checks remain available in their original receipts.
first_actions: Capture Levene 1999 M163 Hebrew-script edition from printed pp. 285–287; compare separately against the scan and retain unresolved glyphs.
Inspect the unclassified/zero-appearance held source inventory for missing edition units, prioritizing primary scholarly articles.
Investigate the 44 non-NLI publication cases through exact identifiers and held-source citations, then the 205 NLI MMS cases using institution-scoped designations and accessible editions.
progress_policy: The frozen publication cohort remains fixed when links are added. Preserve the baseline files; append dated attempts and outcomes in separate campaign checkpoints, bound to current corpus fingerprints. The initialization script is not a progress updater.
